description.value: The Dayton Audio SS15-PR 15" Signature Series Passive Radiator is designed for powerful, high-output subwoofer systems where deep bass extension and clean performance are critical. Built to perfectly complement the SS15-22, this passive radiator uses the same heavy-duty cast aluminum frame, anodized aluminum cone, and rubber surround as its active counterpart, giving it the strength and excursion capability needed for today's most demanding designs. With Dayton Audio's Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) tuning system, fine-tuning your subwoofer enclosure is simple, accurate, and secure.Product HighlightsSignature Series styling with cast aluminum frame, aluminum cone, and rubber surround - visually identical to the SS15-22 driverPassive radiator design enables extended low-frequency response in compact enclosures without port noiseSandwich Mass Structure (SMS) places added mass between spider and surround for stability and symmetryIncludes five 116 g weights for flexible tuning optionsEasy tuning with threaded bolt, wing nut, and nylock nut for secure adjustmentPerfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS15-22 in powerful, high-output passive radiator systemsProduct Manuals / Spec Sheets / DownloadsDayton Audio SS15-PR Specification SheetBuying OptionsBuy on Parts ExpressBuy Internationally
